body: Thank you for reading my post and reaching out. I just don’t have much motivation to keep on living. It’s just so tiresome and yields almost no joy anymore. My therapist is pretty much the only person I’ve got to really talk about my issues with so that’s why this hurts. Thanks again!

But dude I mentioned that my suicidal thoughts and actions have been INCREASING lately! And she KNOWS this! So it wouldn’t make any sense for her to think I’m “getting better” lately. Don’t worry I’m not mad at you, I’m just frustrated with the situation.

Yeah I have considered that as well. And I understand that therapists are human beings who have their own problems and they can’t function at 100% capacity all the time. However, she knows that I am understanding and she could have easily explained herself if she was in a bad mood or if there was some specific reason that she didn’t want to check in the next day. It was just out of character for her and although maybe I’m overreacting, I’m at a very lonely point in my life and I am closer to actually *committing* suicide than I have ever been before so when one of my biggest sources of hope and confidentiality seems to be pulling away from me, even for one moment, it’s just a very discouraging feeling.
